quotes: Up / Down arrorw map to Up / Down buttons
For 935, pressing M in the sim is equivalent to clicking (and holding) on the UP button in the sim.
So it seems that M for KEY_MENU works as long as there is a physical button where a short press or long press opens the menu.
And it specifically doesn't work for touchscreen devices where long-pressing the screen opens the menu.
sources.caveat: This is community evidence rather than a Garmin compatibility guarantee; the physical-button Menu example names 935 and Vivoactive HR rather than fenix6xpro. The release gate therefore treats the table as a bounded candidate and requires exact fenix6xpro fixture markers before activation.

sources.quote: These constants are the virtual keycodes defined originally in Inside Mac Volume V, pg. V-191. They identify physical keys on a keyboard.
